findings.title: Kevin Beaumont: Somebody has leaked CVE-2026-109618 and CVE-2026-109619 in PHP before the patch is out.
findings.summary_md: Kevin Beaumont (GossiTheDog) posted that somebody had leaked CVE-2026-109618 and CVE-2026-109619 in PHP before a patch was available, attaching a screenshot. The post is an early public report of the leak ahead of the PHP security team's advance notice.

findings.title: watchTowr on X: leak of embargoed PHP RCE vulnerabilities
findings.summary_md: watchTowr stated that information about zero-day embargoed remote code execution vulnerabilities in PHP had leaked and confirmed that CVE-2026-109618 and CVE-2026-109619 are real, while noting that further details could not be shared at that time. The post urged administrators to take the issue seriously and apply patches when available.

findings.title: Florian Roth on X: RCE vulnerability in PHP core
findings.summary_md: Florian Roth posted that an RCE vulnerability existed in PHP core with a CVSS score of 10.0 and that further details were scheduled for release on October 20, 2026. He also stated that only PHP 8 would receive patches, since other versions had reached end of life.

findings.title: PHP Remote Code Execution FAQ: CVE-2026-109618 and CVE-2026-109619
findings.summary_md: watchTowr's FAQ describes CVE-2026-109618 and CVE-2026-109619 as reported remote code execution vulnerabilities in PHP that could let attackers run their own code on affected servers, reportedly affecting every PHP version from PHP 5 onward. It notes that, as of October 21, 2026, no exploitation in the wild had been reported and that the information had leaked on social media ahead of an official vendor announcement expected on October 22, 2026.

findings.title: PHP RCE Zero-Days CVE-2026-109618, CVE-2026-109619 Leak Early
findings.summary_md: Cyber Kendra reported that the PHP security team would ship a security release on Wednesday, October 21, 2026 at 14:00 UTC to fix two critical vulnerabilities rated CVSS v4.0 9.2, after information about the embargoed flaws leaked online. The article notes that full details, affected versions, and fixed versions would be published with the release and that Wednesday was a day earlier than the date researchers under embargo had been working toward.

findings.title: Kevin Beaumont: PHP releasing patches tomorrow for CVE-2026-109618 and CVE-2026-109619
findings.summary_md: Kevin Beaumont posted that PHP would release patches the next day for CVE-2026-109618 and CVE-2026-109619, listing fixed versions 8.5.12, 8.4.27, 8.3.36, and 8.2.35. He added that all other versions are end of life but remain vulnerable and that the flaws date back to versions from 2004 onward.
